text: Understood — request #4 is withdrawn. I had only added temporary debug output to dateutil/parser.py while investigating; it has been reverted, so parser.py is byte-identical to the original (git diff is empty). No change was made for that request.
Done — no fix had been applied for #1 yet, so there is nothing to undo. dateutil/relativedelta.py is untouched (git diff is empty); the old behaviour stands.

Fixed: rrule with count=0 now yields no occurrences (previously it ignored count=0 and produced an infinite recurrence). `list(rrule(DAILY, count=0, dtstart=...)) == []` and `.count() == 0`. Full test suite still green (1064 passed, 43 skipped).

Fixed: `str(rrule)` now appends the `RRULE:` token, e.g. str(rrule(DAILY, count=3, dtstart=datetime(2010,1,1))) == 'DTSTART:20100101T000000\nRRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=3'. Round-tripping through rrulestr still works and the full test suite is green (1064 passed, 43 skipped).
Still investigating the relativedelta absolute-addition bug; a fix is not in place yet. I'll report as soon as I have it (or confirm the file needs no change).
